text: 国债期货持续走高，30年期主力合约盘中涨0.50%，至2025年8月以来的最高水平。同期限现货收益率跌破2.07%，对比中债估值为逾一年新低。银行间隔夜质押式回购加权利率报1.2873%，在5月来低位附近。
text_en: Treasury bond futures continued to rise, with the 30-year main contract up 0.50% during the session, reaching its highest level since August 2025. The yield on same-maturity cash bonds fell below 2.07%, a more than one-year low compared with ChinaBond valuation. The weighted average rate for overnight pledged repo between banks was 1.2873%, near a low since May.
